regression.population: all Phase18 actual single-path NORMAL/GRAPH applications; exclude TE ensembles, STOP/recovery and invalid paths; at least8 ticks; truncate at next application, timeout/stop or108 ticks
regression.initial_state: actual application pose, before_v, reset progress=0 for new path; no future commands supplied

rollout.endpoint: unchanged protected PP endpoint tolerance at control ticks
rollout.termination: endpoint,108 ticks,or negative swept oracle footprint lower bound; exact negative witness counted separately
rollout.oracle: passive evaluation only; boxes+outer wall; existing swept_clearance and exact corridor arc minimum reused

SP.curvature: Menger at interior vertices; endpoint repeats nearest interior, zero for2-point path
SP.passes: one backwards braking pass then one forwards acceleration pass, v_i^2 <= v_neighbor^2+2*.5*ds
SP.initial_speed: actual before_v applied through common temporal acceleration cap; not imposed as node0 profile speed
SP.interpolation: linear in geometric arclength, sampled at current nearest projection; execution target floor .05
SP.clipping: omega=clip(v*kappa_PP,+/- .4); curvature infeasibility never silently terminates

curvature.after_B: native Menger triple centered at a vertex whose arclength >= existing nearest B projection; no synthetic timestamps
curvature.ratio: max |curvature| afterB in executed/corrected path divided by native afterB maximum; no valid triple -> unavailable
curvature.sign: signs of respective largest-magnitude remaining curvature; not physical turn correspondence
curvature.K: max(0,abs(native_i)-abs(corrected_i))/.5, all6 native triples, exact inherited Menger XY derivative
curvature.KP: remove endpoint_progress rows only when original afterB max>=2; all other factors/constraints and acceptance fixed

A.final_cause: last actually tracked path at terminal interval; no path tracking during STOP/recovery -> OTHER
A.same_box: nearest box x-center to each B; first contiguous SAFE passage through box x extent +/- .30m; different observation/pose paths, not a causal match
A.attribution: last submitted job before failure, exactly one each CLR/NO_PROGRESS/NO_CLEARANCE/NO_BOTH; solver rejection retained; CLEARANCE_PUSH requires this job to be final active correction, off accepted, wall clearance gain>=.02

B.original: actual depth-selected sample transformed by observation pose
B.previous_prior: same stored previous accepted path, no counterfactual propagation
B.stored_CLR: numerical accepted solution; runtime scheduling disposition retained; no fabricated result for missing terminal job
B.unavailable: STOP_WAIT/KEEP_ACTIVE/recovery with no graph job and rejected/missing solutions explicitly unavailable; all10 rows per event retained
B.primary_population: all5 paths available/accepted at same event, to avoid comparing unmatched denominators; acceptance rates use all512 submitted inputs; method-available results descriptive
B.speed_example: first sorted SLW common-valid turning event, saved CLR path, both speed rules

selection.interpretation: all10 combinations from user table are eligible; SAFE/HERMITE may win, making NO_CANDIDATE unlikely unless common evidence absent
selection.safety: SLW overlap count <= SAFE+CURV on common population
selection.speed: largest CL mean distance, common population
selection.timing: new constructor+solve+certificate excluding snapshot I/O and oracle evaluation; p95 among started solves, all-attempt stats also retained; stored CLR solve+certificate times
selection.acceptance: new variant lower bound no10pp-or-greater drop from stored CLR upper bound; missing baseline worker result explicitly bounded

figures: CLR SLW failed seeds66-73, final active path or explicitly labelled last returned iterate; accepted-only factor ratio distribution; common-case combo scatter; same-path speed example
